## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle commentary on *Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 ([KR6g0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0001)) is by [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) Guàndǐng (561–632), the principal disciple of [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) Zhìyǐ and the second patriarch of the Tiāntái school. The *xuán yì* "profound meaning" format provides a doctrinal preamble to the larger sūtra, in the standard Tiāntái scholastic genre.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (597–632) reflects Guàndǐng's mature Tiāntái scholarly activity, beginning with Zhìyǐ's death.
